Further, the redemption price of SGB shall be based on simple average of closing price of gold of 999 purity of previous three business days from the date of redemption, as published by the India Bullion and Jewellers Association Ltd (IBJA). Accordingly, the redemption price for premature redemption due on November 02, 2026, shall be ₹14,167/- (Rupees Fourteen Thousand One Hundred and Sixty-Seven Only) per unit of SGB based on the simple average of closing price of gold for the three business days i.e., October 28, October 29, and October 30, 2026.
